columns.name: birth_date
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (birth_date IS NULL OR birth_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]')

columns.name: report_date
columns.customConstraints: CHECK (report_date IS NULL OR report_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]')

data.name: extraction
constraints: CHECK(status = 'failed' OR payload IS NOT NULL)

data.name: observation
constraints: CHECK(value_kind <> 'quantity' OR value_num IS NOT NULL)
CHECK(modality <> 'derived' OR derived_from IS NOT NULL)
CHECK(status = 'final' OR amends IS NOT NULL)
CHECK(ref_low IS NULL OR ref_high IS NULL OR ref_low <= ref_high)

columns.name: observation_id
columns.customConstraints: NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES observation(id)ON DELETE CASCADE

data.name: v_observation
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_observation AS SELECT o.*, k.terminology_release, k.outcome, k.reason AS coding_reason, k.code_system, k.code, k.series_id, k.group_id, k.value_canonical, k.unit_canonical, k.decision_id, c.display, c.display_de, c.short_name, c.category, c.component, c.property, c.time_aspect, c.system, c.scale, c.method FROM observation AS o JOIN coding_current AS k ON k.observation_id = o.id LEFT JOIN concept AS c ON c.terminology_release = k.terminology_release AND c.code_system = k.code_system AND c.code = k.code WHERE o.status = 'final' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation AS n WHERE n.amends = o.id)

columns.name: report_id
columns.customConstraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES report(id)ON DELETE CASCADE

columns.name: source_file_id
columns.customConstraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES source_file(id)ON DELETE CASCADE

data.name: v_report_page
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_report_page AS SELECT f.report_id, f.id AS source_file_id, f.position AS file_position, p.page_ix AS file_page_ix, p.text_origin, ROW_NUMBER()OVER (PARTITION BY f.report_id, p.text_origin ORDER BY f.position, p.page_ix RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) - 1 AS report_page_ix, p.markdown FROM source_page AS p JOIN source_file AS f ON f.id = p.source_file_id

data.name: idx_coding_current_series
data.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_coding_current_series ON coding_current (series_id, observation_id);

data.name: idx_coding_current_open
data.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_coding_current_open ON coding_current (outcome) WHERE outcome <> 'coded';

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "birth_date" TEXT CHECK (birth_date IS NULL OR birth_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "sex" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (sex IN ('unknown', 'female', 'male', 'other')), "default_tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "report" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "person_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES person(id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "report_date" TEXT CHECK (report_date IS NULL OR report_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "date_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (date_source IN ('', 'extracted', 'file-date', 'manual')), "lab_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'ocr', 'extracting', 'review', 'done', 'failed')), "error" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER, CHECK(status <> 'failed' OR error <> ''), CHECK((report_date IS NULL)=(date_source = '')));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extraction" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "person_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES person(id), "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('file', 'manual', 'health-connect', 'healthkit', 'device-file')), "source_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "report_id" INTEGER REFERENCES report(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "extractor" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ok', 'failed', 'unverified')), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "payload" TEXT, "digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(source_ref, digest), CHECK(status = 'ok' OR reason <> ''), CHECK(status = 'failed' OR payload IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "observation" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "person_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES person(id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('measurement', 'symptom', 'condition', 'note', 'finding', 'organizer')), "modality" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (modality IN ('lab-report', 'device-sensed', 'self-reported', 'manual', 'derived', 'llm-unverified')), "source_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('file', 'manual', 'health-connect', 'healthkit', 'device-file')), "source_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_record_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "extraction_id" INTEGER REFERENCES extraction(id), "report_id" INTEGER REFERENCES report(id), "page_ix" INTEGER CHECK (page_ix IS NULL OR page_ix >= 0), "row_ix" INTEGER CHECK (row_ix IS NULL OR row_ix >= 0), "vendor" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "vendor_field" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "source_class" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_class IN ('measurer', 'profile-echo', 'aggregator', 'manual')), "derived_from" TEXT, "member_of" INTEGER REFERENCES observation(id), "panel_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "observed_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "observed_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz_source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tz_source IN ('iana', 'offset-only', 'floating', 'user-default')), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (local_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "grain" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (grain IN ('instant', 'window', 'day')), "stat" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (stat IN ('', 'average', 'minimum', 'maximum', 'sum', 'count', 'last')), "name_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unit_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ref_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "flag_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "method_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "specimen_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "note_text" TEXT, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_kind IN ('quantity', 'ordinal', 'nominal', 'narrative', 'absent')), "value_num" REAL, "value_decimals" INTEGER CHECK (value_decimals IS NULL OR value_decimals >= 0), "comparator" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (comparator IN ('', '<', '<=', '>', '>=')), "value_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "data_absent_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unit_ucum" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ref_low" REAL, "ref_high" REAL, "ref_comparator" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (ref_comparator IN ('', '<', '<=', '>', '>=')), "flag" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (flag IN ('', 'low', 'high', 'critical-low', 'critical-high', 'abnormal')), "local_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "stream_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'final' CHECK (status IN ('final', 'entered-in-error')), "amends" INTEGER REFERENCES observation(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK(observed_end >= observed_start), CHECK(grain <> 'instant' OR observed_start = observed_end), CHECK(grain = 'instant' OR stat <> ''), CHECK(value_kind <> 'absent' OR data_absent_reason <> ''), CHECK(value_kind <> 'quantity' OR value_num IS NOT NULL), CHECK(modality <> 'derived' OR derived_from IS NOT NULL), CHECK(status = 'final' OR amends IS NOT NULL), CHECK(ref_low IS NULL OR ref_high IS NULL OR ref_low <= ref_high));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coding_decision" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) = 16), "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_ucum" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "value_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (value_kind IN ('quantity', 'ordinal', 'nominal', 'narrative', 'absent')), "terminology_release" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, "evidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "rejected" TEXT, "human" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coding_current" ("observation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES observation(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "terminology_release" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('coded', 'needs-input', 'refused')), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "code_system" TEXT, "code" TEXT, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT, "value_canonical" REAL, "unit_canonical" TEXT, "decision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coding_decision(id), "coded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, CHECK((outcome = 'coded')=(code IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((code IS NULL)=(code_system IS NULL)), CHECK(outcome = 'coded' OR reason <> ''), CHECK((value_canonical IS NULL)=(unit_canonical IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "concept" ("terminology_release" TEXT NOT NULL, "code_system" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "display" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_de" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "short_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "component" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "property" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "time_aspect" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "system" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "scale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "method" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY(terminology_release, code_system, code));

CREATE VIEW v_observation AS SELECT o.*, k.terminology_release, k.outcome, k.reason AS coding_reason, k.code_system, k.code, k.series_id, k.group_id, k.value_canonical, k.unit_canonical, k.decision_id, c.display, c.display_de, c.short_name, c.category, c.component, c.property, c.time_aspect, c.system, c.scale, c.method FROM observation AS o JOIN coding_current AS k ON k.observation_id = o.id LEFT JOIN concept AS c ON c.terminology_release = k.terminology_release AND c.code_system = k.code_system AND c.code = k.code WHERE o.status = 'final' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM observation AS n WHERE n.amends = o.id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_file" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "person_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES person(id), "report_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES report(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0), "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content_hash) = 64), "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_size" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (byte_size >= 0), "stored_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('pdf', 'image', 'other')), "import_channel" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (import_channel IN ('file-picker', 'drag-drop', 'camera', 'gallery', 'share')), "page_count" INTEGER CHECK (page_count IS NULL OR page_count > 0), "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(person_id, content_hash), UNIQUE(report_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_page" ("source_file_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES source_file(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "page_ix" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (page_ix >= 0), "text_origin" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (text_origin <> ''), "markdown" TEXT NOT NULL, "tables_html" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(source_file_id, page_ix, text_origin));

CREATE VIEW v_report_page AS SELECT f.report_id, f.id AS source_file_id, f.position AS file_position, p.page_ix AS file_page_ix, p.text_origin, ROW_NUMBER()OVER (PARTITION BY f.report_id, p.text_origin ORDER BY f.position, p.page_ix RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE NO OTHERS) - 1 AS report_page_ix, p.markdown FROM source_page AS p JOIN source_file AS f ON f.id = p.source_file_id
CREATE INDEX idx_coding_current_series ON coding_current (series_id, observation_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_coding_current_open ON coding_current (outcome) WHERE outcome <> 'coded'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coding_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "observation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES observation(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "cause" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cause IN ('ingest', 'amend', 'correct', 'recode-release', 'recode-rules', 'recode-alias')), "terminology_release" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('coded', 'needs-input', 'refused')), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "code_system" TEXT, "code" TEXT, "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT, "value_canonical" REAL, "unit_canonical" TEXT, "decision_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coding_decision(id), "coded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_coding_history_observation ON coding_history (observation_id, coded_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coding_alias" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope = 'global' OR scope GLOB 'person:[0-9]*'), "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_ucum" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "code_system" TEXT, "code" TEXT, "confirmed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', UNIQUE(scope, name_key, unit_ucum), CHECK((code IS NULL)=(code_system IS NULL)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_observation_identity ON observation (person_id, name_key, observed_start, observed_end, source_ref, source_record_id, COALESCE(member_of, 0), COALESCE(amends, 0))
CREATE INDEX idx_observation_day ON observation (person_id, local_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_observation_stream ON observation (person_id, stream_key, observed_start)
CREATE INDEX idx_observation_source ON observation (source_ref)
CREATE INDEX idx_observation_report ON observation (report_id) WHERE report_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_observation_amends ON observation (amends) WHERE amends IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_observation_created ON observation (person_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_extraction_report ON extraction (report_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_report_person_date ON report (person_id, report_date)
